clips.title: The story
paras: Myzrael cries out that she is free, and that she will gather her strength in hiding from her captors. She calls you a noble ally and sends you to Gerrig Bonegrip in a shop of Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern, who knows how she can be summoned.

Myzrael is free, and means to gather strength hidden from her captors, since if they met her now they would surely overpower her and lock her away again. In time she means to face the giants, and she swears they will rue having held her. She calls you a noble ally and says she will need your help again, to summon her to the surface when she is ready.
Myzrael tells you to speak with Gerrig Bonegrip, whose shop is in Ironforge, in the Forlorn Cavern. He knows how she can be summoned.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Free! I AM FREE! I am free to gather strength, hidden from my captors. For if they faced me now they would surely overpower and again imprison me.
But in time I will confront the giants, and they will regret their wardship of me!
You are a noble ally, friend. I will need your help again in time. When I am ready, I will need you to summon me to the surface.
Speak with Gerrig Bonegrip. He is in Ironforge, in a shop of the Forlorn Cavern. He knows how I can be summoned.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Lady told me of your coming, adventurer. You are welcome in my abode for you, like I, serve a higher cause.
